notes.title: [SPOILERS] Everything explained.
notes.content:
Back when this game originally released, I received a lot of steamy, angry emails and postcards regarding what this all meant. 

Eventually, my conscience couldn't take it anymore, and this Q&A video was made to help those who had questions sleep better at night.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0hnbwI3G3DI
Thanks for your patience, and hope you enjoyed the game.

-Kan
